definitions.explanation: A person walking along a street or path. Often used in news reports about incidents involving uninvolved bystanders or witnesses on the road.

examples.japanese: {通行人|つうこうにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I asked a passerby for directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通行人|つうこうにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Many passersby gathered at the accident scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倒|たお}れていた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通行人|つうこうにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{助|たす}け→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: A passerby helped the man who had collapsed and immediately called an ambulance.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧ (passing through) + ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person). Refers to people happening to be on a road or street at a given time — often appears in news, police reports, and witness contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通行人|つうこうにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}をかける→声をかける：30589_koewokakeru⟧: to call out to a passerby
- {通行人|つうこうにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask a passerby for directions
- {通行人|つうこうにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧: a passerby helps
- {通行人|つうこうにん}⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: extra (in TV/film, playing a passerby)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}→歩行者：03152_hokousha⟧: pedestrian — formal/legal term, used in traffic rules (⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}{天国|てんごく}→歩行者天国：30635_hokoushatengoku⟧)
- {道行|みちゆ}く⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: people walking the street — literary/descriptive
- {人通|ひとどお}り: foot traffic — refers to the flow of people, not individuals
